method.title: How these numbers are made
method.mrr: MRR sums the catalogue list price of every subscription with status “active”: monthly plans at the monthly price, yearly plans at one twelfth of the yearly price. Stripe amounts, discounts, taxes and credits are not applied.
method.atRisk: MRR at risk is the same calculation for subscriptions that are past due or unpaid.
method.trials: Trials never count towards MRR. The trial section only shows what the ledger carries.
method.overage: Overage uses the period’s usage counters against the plan limit and the catalogue packs. Policy “pause” bills nothing; “cost limit” bills at most the packs within the limit.
method.invoices: Invoices are read live from Stripe and are the only Stripe amounts on this page. Nothing here is a booked figure; the ledger follows Stripe webhooks.
